priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Do not write issued tokens to logs
findings.body: Every token passed to `recordIssuedToken` is emitted verbatim through `console.log`. In environments where console output is collected or accessible to operators, support staff, or log-processing systems, anyone with log access can recover and use the bearer token until it expires.

findings.title: [P1] Restrict return URLs before navigation
findings.body: `finishLogin` now passes an unrestricted caller-supplied string to `location.assign`. Values such as `https://attacker.example`, `//attacker.example`, or `javascript:...` can cause phishing redirects or script execution after login. Accept only validated same-origin application paths.
